objective: Replace the 12-node conceptual proof with a site-grounded time-expanded network while keeping a strict separation between observed/public baselines and synthetic demand assumptions.

network_layers.hard_rule: Must remain continuous through every scenario unless an emergency closure is explicitly represented.
No road-redline or engineering-width claim from OSM.
Service edges activate only within verified operating windows.
Unknown hours remain unknown; no invented opening schedule.

network_layers.role: T0-T3 permissions, priorities, stop and rollback states
network_layers.hard_rule: AI may optimize within rights; it may not overwrite T0.

scenario_comparison.description: Static spatial network without time-window coordination; used only as comparison model.
Weekday with morning/evening human-priority windows and verified transit/POI schedules.
Same service volume redistributed into lower-conflict windows under T0-T3 contracts.
Human-confirmed event layer with high crowd load and automatic machine-activity withdrawal triggers.
Sensor/comms degradation or accessible-route conflict forces rollback to T0/T1.

proof_model_already_completed.claim_boundary: Proof-of-method only. Values are not observed Jingzhang performance and will be replaced/recomputed after site-grounded network and time data are assembled.
